children: SINGAPORE, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Marsh and Resilience today announced the launch of

in Asia. An innovative offering that helps clients respond to emerging cyber threats before they become losses. Available exclusively through Marsh in Asia, Cyber Protect combines Marsh's expertise in cyber insurance placement with
Risk Operations Center (ROC), a 24/7 proactive cyber risk monitoring and detection service included as a core part of the Cyber Protect Program at no additional cost to clients.

Cyber Protect is designed to help clients identify critical vulnerabilities earlier and improve their risk profile by remediating risks likely to cause financial loss. The offering is available to organizations that purchase cyber insurance brokered by Marsh and is available across Asia, excluding China.
This offering combines:
Marsh's expertise in cyber insurance placement, backed by deep claims experience across the region.

24/7, AI-powered monitoring and proactive threat hunting service that continuously scans a policyholder's external-facing infrastructure to surface critical vulnerabilities and exposures before they can be exploited.

Human-validated alerts that filter out noise, so clients see only the risks that warrant action, with clear remediation guidance to enable security teams to close gaps faster and with more confidence.
A layer that works alongside existing security controls, with no software installation or internal system access required.
The launch comes as organizations across Asia face mounting pressure from AI-driven cyber threats. According to

, only 50% of Asia-based organizations are confident in their cyber risk management and mitigation initiatives, the lowest level of confidence globally and well below the worldwide average of 72%. Almost three in 10 cyber and social engineering attacks globally target Asia, underscoring the need for stronger cyber resilience and earlier threat detection.

"As cyber threats continue to accelerate, prevention alone is no longer sufficient. Managing cyber risk today demands both the ability to detect and respond to threats early, and the financial protection to recover when the inevitable incident occurs," said Sean Letz, Cyber Leader, Marsh Asia. "Cyber Protect helps clients detect critical vulnerabilities earlier, take action faster, and strengthen their risk profile, supporting stronger resilience, improved insurability, and greater confidence in recovery."

"Asia represents one of the most important developing cyber risk markets in the world, and we are proud to be bringing this unique solution to market with Marsh," said Mario Vitale, President of Resilience. "We built Resilience around a single belief: that the highest value we can deliver is a loss that never happens. Our platform continuously hunts for threats across clients' external attack surfaces, prioritizing the vulnerabilities most likely to cause financial harm before an attacker can act. Asian businesses now have access to that capability — together with the expertise of one of the world's most trusted insurance partners."

For more information, visit corporate.marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
About Resilience

Resilience helps organizations become cyber resilient to material losses by staying ahead of bad actors. Founded by experts from across the highest tiers of the US military and intelligence communities – and built by prominent leaders and innovators from the cybersecurity, technology, and insurance industries – Resilience is the world's first cyber risk company that offers risk quantification software, cybersecurity experts, and highly rated insurance in solutions purpose-built for large and middle-market organizations.

Resilience's Risk Operations Center (ROC) is an AI-powered monitoring service that actively hunts for zero-day vulnerabilities and scans a policyholder's external-facing infrastructure for known vulnerabilities, exposed high-risk remote services, insecure remote access points, and dark web exposure. The ROC cuts through the noise of traditional security alerts, providing actionable remediation advice to stop threats before they become incidents, and losses.  Each year, the ROC screens out roughly 95% of known vulnerabilities as low risk, escalating only the small number that pose a real, exploitable threat, and clients have historically remediated 77% of those escalations.
